FR-001.title: Chart of Accounts screen provides a Print Chart of Accounts button

FR-002.title: Screen provides an off-by-default option to include current balances

FR-003.title: Print produces a document listing every active account

FR-004.title: Document groups accounts by type in fixed order

FR-005.title: Accounts within a type section ordered by account number ascending

FR-006.title: Each row shows number, name, and system/bank indicator

FR-007.title: Balance shown per account when include-balances is on

FR-008.title: Printed balance matches the Chart of Accounts screen's figure

FR-009.title: No balance column when include-balances is off

FR-010.title: Per-account balance error shows an indicator without blocking the rest

FR-011.title: Archived accounts excluded from the document

FR-014.title: Report also available from the central Reports menu with CSV export

context: area: src/StageFright.Reports/Providers/*.cs (existing IReportProvider pattern, e.g. TrialBalanceReportProvider)
constraint: per-account balance failures isolated (HasError indicator), never break the rest of the report
constraint: reports contributed only through IReportProvider, auto-discovered via DI — no menu code needed
constraint: Print/CSV hand off to the OS default app via a temp file, never an in-app viewer
intent: Let a user print the chart of accounts, grouped by account type/number, with an optional current-balance column
expectations: Archived accounts are not included in the printed report
No combined grand-total balance figure is shown
No new persisted entity or migration — reuses the existing Account entity and balance calculation
